verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs include a dedicated 'Feeds' guide, a first-party inbound feed capability that matches the story's 'feeds' wording. The pack contains only the page title, so the depth and the range of supported third-party sources are unproven. Warehouse Sync ingests from the customer's own warehouse, not third-party cloud apps, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: description of which third-party cloud apps/partners can send data via Feeds, setup/configuration docs, any mapping or identity handling for partner feeds, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps
